Reference Application — Application that comprises a component and
Reference Artifact — Artifact generated by a component, classified
as an asset, and persisted to a data store.
Reference Asset — Asset owned by an actor, protected by a control,
and derived from an artifact in the reference model.
Reference Activity — Activity that receives an event and
triggers downstream activities, events, conditions, actors,
Triggered Activity — Secondary activity used as the
target of Activity/Event triggers in the reference model.
Reference Capability — Capability used to satisfy a requirement
and to run both a process and a state machine.
Reference Class — Class target for implement relationships
Reference Constraint — Constraint implied by a story and limiting
a requirement in the reference model.
Reference Component — Component used to exercise interface calls,
artifact generation, implementation links, and execution links.
Reference Control — Control that mitigates risk and protects an asset
Reference Driver — Motivation used to drive a downstream
requirement in the relationship-matrix reference model.
Reference Data Store — Data store that exposes an interface and
Reference Feature — Feature that enables a capability in the
Reference Interface — Interface that can be called by a component
and exposed by a data store.
Relationship Matrix Reference — Reference Aurora model encoding the
requested relationship matrix as concrete card links for tooling and

both a capability and a component.
Reference Requirement — Requirement referenced by multiple rules

Reference Risk — Risk presented by actors/threats and mitigated by
Reference Test — Test target for implement relationships in the
